description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between Loss Ratio (%) and TFLOPS for several models. The x-axis is labeled "TFLOPS" and uses a linear scale ranging from 1e7 to 9e8, with tick labels displayed at intervals of 1e7. The y-axis is labeled "Loss Ratio (%)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 94 to 100, with tick labels displayed at intervals of 1. 

The line representing "Vanilla" is purple with triangle markers and a solid line style, starting at approximately 97.8% at 1e7 TFLOPS and remaining steady at approximately 99.8% from 2e7 TFLOPS onwards. The line representing "SepLLM (n=64)" is orange with cross markers and a solid line style, starting at approximately 98.2% at 1e7 TFLOPS and increasing to approximately 99.7% at 9e8 TFLOPS. The line representing “SepLLM (n=128)” is blue with cross markers and a solid line style, starting at approximately 97.1% at 1e7 TFLOPS and increasing to approximately 99.6% at 9e8 TFLOPS. The line representing “SepLLM (n=64, H)” is green with triangle markers and a solid line style, starting at approximately 97.3% at 1e7 TFLOPS and increasing to approximately 99.3% at 9e8 TFLOPS. Finally, the line representing “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” is red with circle markers and a solid line style, starting at approximately 94.3% at 1e7 TFLOPS, increasing to approximately 98.5% at 2e7 TFLOPS, then varying between approximately 98.2% and 98.7% for the remainder of the x-axis values.
